Three.js 0.180.0, MIT license (see LICENSE).

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
Files obtained from the version-pinned npm distribution at https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/.
OrbitControls.js and SVGLoader.js have their `three` import rewritten to `./three.module.js` for self-hosted use without a bundler or external runtime requests. Two upstream indentation-only whitespace issues are normalized; library behavior is unchanged.
